table.retrieve:
SELECT  
		 aliasname=i.customicode,
		 I.name,
		 OH.POCode,
	    OH.Date,
       Acc.name, 
		 S.address1,  
		 S.address2,
		 S.city,
		 S.phone,
		 S.fax,
		 OH.remarks,
		 OH.purorderterms1,
		 OH.purorderterms2,
		 OH.purorderterms3,
		 OH.purorderterms4,
		 OH.purorderterms5,
		 OH.purorderterms6,
		 OH.purorderterms7,
		 OH.purorderterms8,
		 OH.Misccharges,
		 OH.Discperc,
		 I.packingdesc,
       OD.rate,
       OD.qty,
		 OD.bonusqty,
		 OD.discperc,
       amount= (OD.qty * OD.rate) * ( 1 - (OD.discperc * 0.01) ) 


FROM item I, accounts Acc, purorderheader OH, purorderdetail OD , Supplier S

WHERE OH.pocode >= :ai_sPOCode AND
		OH.pocode <= :ai_lPOCode AND
      OH.pocode=OD.pocode AND
		OH.suppCode = S.SuppCode AND
      OH.suppcode=Acc.acccode AND
      OD.icode=I.icode

order by oh.pocode, i.name
